cmgap-U30.detail: CodeMartV1AIAnalysisCtl::acceptProposal (:235-302) reads the key with CodeMartV1FinanceService::idempotencyKey() (:240; IDEMPOTENCY_HEADER, trimmed and capped at 255), the same helper that deposits and payments use. It checks for a replay after the ownership check (:245) and again under the analysis row lock inside the transaction (:259-260; AIAnalysisModel::lockById :90 and isAcceptReplay :96, which uses hash_equals and needs accepted_at). On PostgreSQL, a waiting FOR UPDATE returns the committed row, so a concurrent request with the same key also replays. The key is stored with accepted_at (:276), and the column is fillable. acceptedResponse() (:216) builds the same body for the first call and for a replay. The CodeMart routes do not use the global 'idempotent' middleware, so the controller path is the only replay path. Probe re-run (HTTP kernel, rolled back, analysis 1 / project 2). Key A: 200, project proposal_review to funding_pending (state_revision 1 to 2). Key A again: 200, byte-identical body, state_revision still 2, 0 new activity rows. Key B and a call without a key: both 409 invalid_project_transition. The stored key is key A. After the rollback, accepted_at and the key are null and the project is back in proposal_review.

non_blocking: cmgap-U30 verify wording: the verify asks for 'exactly one activity row'. Call 1 writes 2 rows: the project funding_pending transition from ProjectStateService::systemTransition, and the analysis 'accepted' event (AIAnalysisCtl.php:280-292). Carried from laravel-codemart-D7-fix. (1) ensure() writes the secret file before seedAccounts()/apply(); if either throws, the next seed sees an existing file and never applies it until codemart:admin-password runs (Step175 runs it on every deploy). This follows the ruling. (2) CodeMartV1AdminPassword::write() repeats FileSystemManager::writePrivateFile() (app/Utils/FileSystemManager.php:134), which hardcodes 0600, while write() keeps the contract-driven file_mode. Optional.
